title: Gourmet has so many layers of meaning In front of Jelly Beans It means, "Gross" #smallpoems
summary: Gourmet has so many layers of meaning In front of Jelly Beans It means, "Gross" #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Gourmet has so many
layers of meaning
In front of Jelly Beans
It means, "Gross"
#smallpoems
